THE WIDGET LEVY ACT
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
16. Eligibility and conditions for taking widget credit.
17. Apportionment of credit and blocked credits.

CHAPTER V WIDGET CREDIT

16. Eligibility and conditions for taking widget
credit.—(1) Every registered person shall be entitled to take credit of levy paid.
(2) No registered person shall be entitled to the credit unless,—
(a) he is in possession of a levy invoice;
(b) he has received the widgets.
(3) Where the registered person has claimed depreciation on the levy component,
the credit on the said levy component shall not be allowed.

CHAPTER V WIDGET CREDIT

(4) A registered person shall not be entitled to take credit after the [thirtieth day
of November]67 following the end of the financial year.
67 Substituted w.e.f. 01.10.2022 for "due date" by The Widget Levy (Amendment)
Act, 2022 (No. 6 of 2022).

CHAPTER V WIDGET CREDIT

17. Apportionment of credit and blocked credits. — (1) Where the widgets are used
partly for business, the credit shall be restricted to the business share.
(2) Credit shall not be available for widgets used for personal consumption.

CHAPTER V WIDGET CREDIT

[17A. Transfer of credit .-(1) A registered person may transfer unused credit.
